description: Auditable overrides for known errors in the upstream Perseus / Scaife-Viewer encoding of Cunliffe's Homer citations. scripts/build_cunliffe_lexicon.py applies these after ingesting the upstream ATLAS JSON, tagging each corrected citation with its correction id (citation['correction']). Reversible: delete a correction here (or this whole file) and rebuild to restore the upstream value verbatim; each correction records the upstream 'original' in full. A correction that no longer matches the upstream (e.g. the upstream fixed or moved it) makes the build fail loudly rather than silently skip.

corrections.evidence: The phrase ἀάατον Στυγὸς ὕδωρ is Iliad 14.271 (ἄγρει νῦν μοι ὄμοσσον ἀάατον Στυγὸς ὕδωρ, Hypnos to Hera in the Dios Apate). Cunliffe's printed citation is book Ξ (= Iliad 14), preserved verbatim in the independent archive.org 'CunliffeHomericLexicon' flat-text transcription. The Perseus / Scaife-Viewer TEI mis-encoded the book number as 18.
corrections.source: Homer, Iliad 14.271; cross-checked against the archive.org CunliffeHomericLexicon flat text (book Ξ = 14).
